## Proposed Changes

- Briefly describe the purpose of this PR and what changes have been made.
- If this fixes a bug or implements a feature request, include relevant context or link to the issue.
- Clearly state **what** changed and **why**.

- [Jira Ticket](https://angloeasterngroup.atlassian.net/browse/__)

## Type of Change
_Put an `x` in the boxes that apply_

- [ ] Bugfix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Refactoring (code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature, but improves code structure, readability, or performance)
- [ ] Test-only change (adds or updates tests without affecting production code)
- [ ] Chore (routine task like build process updates, dependency bumps, or housekeeping with no production impact)
- [ ] Documentation Update (if none of the other choices apply)

## Checklist

_Put an `x` in the boxes that apply. These are reminders to help ensure a smooth and complete PR._

- [ ] Code compiles and passes all unit/integration tests
- [ ] Unit tests have been added or updated
- [ ] Documentation/API Contract has been updated (if necessary)
- [ ] Code follows existing style guidelines
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published

## Testing

- Describe how the changes were tested
- Include any relevant details such as:
  - Unit test scenarios covered
  - Integration/API test notes
  - Environment testing

## Additional Notes

- If this is a large or complex change, explain your approach and any key decisions or trade-offs made.
- Mention any follow-up work that might be needed.

## Screenshots / Logs / Output (if applicable)

> ⚠️ Please ensure that no sensitive information (e.g., personal data, credentials, internal URLs) is included in screenshots or logs.

- Paste sanitized logs, screenshots, or sample output only if it helps reviewers understand or verify your changes.
